scope: Complete shape512 original 12-step/21-forward sampler; stock SDPA and original weights/LoRA. Source head-first views preserve CPU output bitwise, but the intended RoPE device layout was not retained.
finding: Source-level head-first views do not realize the intended device layout. Native IR retains all120 RoPE multiplies with token-first phase shapes and padded 12-head rows, with60 extra typecasts vs control. The candidate is slower (650.0ms vs625.7ms per forward, 13.63s vs13.21s sampler) and differs 30.6% from TT control at final state despite exact CPU preparation.
decision: Reject this implementation as an optimization. Test explicit contiguity and rank-two flattened head/token arithmetic in a small native kernel probe; require actual IR layout evidence before another complete-flow trial. Defaults remain unchanged.
note: StableHLO/TTIR contain head-first operations, while final native TTNN IR returns RoPE arithmetic to token-first layouts. The exact rewrite mechanism has not been isolated; do not claim Python shape order fixes physical tiling.
